title: Azor Smp Pack
description: its the rescource pack for azor smp plugin.
body:
First public release of the **Azor Resource Pack** for Azor Plugin.

## Added

- Custom weapon models for Azor Plugin
- Custom textures for all current weapons
- Support for custom model data
- Pack icon/logo

## Included Models

- Scythe
- Katana
- Jester's Grin
- Demon Sword
- Champion's Blade
- Ice Bow
- Yumi of the Silent Samurai

## Notes

This resource pack is made for [**Azor Plugin**](https://modrinth.com/plugin/azor-smp-plugin).  
Install it with the plugin to see the custom weapon models.

A tutorial video will be available to explain setup and usage.

If you find bugs or missing textures, please join the Discord and submit a report:

https://discord.gg/nMRZWW4MDS
